headline: O.M Operation Mole Day 1: ₹17.70 Cr India nett
lede: O.M Operation Mole's Day 1 collection so far, on Saturday, 21 November 2026, is ₹17.70 Cr India nett and ₹20.55 Cr India gross, with no previous day on the ledger. That is across 6,628 shows at 45.6% occupancy. Updated 03:26 am IST, and still a live estimate rather than the final drop.
body:
Through Day 1 the desk has O.M Operation Mole at ₹35.40 Cr India nett, ₹20.55 Cr India gross, ₹11.00 Cr overseas and ₹35.40 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹17.70 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, Ramayana at ₹16.30 Cr and ENE Repeat at ₹3.10 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by O.M Operation Mole. The desk figure remains ₹35.40 Cr India nett and ₹35.40 Cr worldwide. No producer-certified total is included.
